title: Strengthening Financial Integrity and International Trust: UAE’s FATCA/CRS Framework
summary: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its website AI assistant gives real-time FATCA/CRS guidance. Changes in service quality or reporting work are unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its website includes an AI conversational assistant that answers FATCA/CRS inquiries and provides real-time guidance. The main reporting platform uses rules, without model training. Counts of reporting institutions and international exchange partners describe that wider infrastructure. The assistant’s effect on inquiry resolution, staff time, or user experience is unmeasured.
purpose: Help users obtain guidance about FATCA/CRS reporting requirements.
system: UAE Ministry of Finance FATCA/CRS inquiry assistant

ratings.reason: The Ministry reports that an AI assistant provides real-time reporting guidance, but gives no measured improvement in inquiry handling or reporting work attributable to the assistant.

ai_role.statement: The identified AI function is conversational guidance for reporting inquiries. Registration, validation and international tax-data exchange belong to a separately described rule-based platform.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 7: Strengthening Financial Integrity and International Trust: UAE’s FATCA/CRS Framework

produced_by: A website conversational AI assistant provides FATCA/CRS guidance
must_hold: Current FATCA/CRS guidance and access to the Ministry website. Other requirements for the assistant are unspecified.

headline: AI assistant answers UAE FATCA/CRS reporting inquiries
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
